nodes.summary: Let $B_r$ denote the open disc of radius $r$ about the origin of the Euclidean plane $\mathbb{R}^2$. The annulus $\Omega_1$ is $B_3 \setminus \overline{B}_1$, the set of points of $B_3$ outside the closure of $B_1$, that is, $\Omega_1 = \{x \in \mathbb{R}^2 : 1 < |x| < 3\}$.
nodes.title: The annulus of the critical weighted Sobolev inequality

nodes.summary: $\Omega_1 = B_3 \setminus \overline{B}_1$, where $B_r$ is the open disc of radius $r$ about the origin of the Euclidean plane $\mathbb{R}^2$ and $\overline{B}_1$ is the closure of $B_1$; that is, writing $|x|$ for the Euclidean norm, $\Omega_1$ is the annulus $\{x \in \mathbb{R}^2 : 1 < |x| < 3\}$.
nodes.title: Full annulus of the weighted Hardy inequality

nodes.summary: Let $B_r$ denote the open disc of radius $r$ about the origin of the Euclidean plane $\mathbb{R}^2$. The outer annulus $\Omega_2$ is $B_3 \setminus \overline{B}_2$, the set of points of $B_3$ outside the closure of $B_2$, that is, $\Omega_2 = \{x \in \mathbb{R}^2 : 2 < |x| < 3\}$.
nodes.title: The outer annulus of the critical weighted Sobolev inequality

nodes.summary: $\Omega_2 = B_3 \setminus \overline{B}_2$, where $B_r$ is the open disc of radius $r$ about the origin of the Euclidean plane $\mathbb{R}^2$ and $\overline{B}_2$ is the closure of $B_2$; that is, writing $|x|$ for the Euclidean norm, $\Omega_2$ is the annulus $\{x \in \mathbb{R}^2 : 2 < |x| < 3\}$.
